jobs.title: Head of Semiconductor Technology, US
jobs.description:
About Us

ZEISS is a global technology and innovation leader in optics and optoelectronics. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS operates in 50+ countries and offers career opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, research, sales, and technology.

As a foundation-owned company, ZEISS is committed to responsibility, quality, and continuous innovation. Employees help shape the future through cutting-edge technology and impactful work. With a strong North American presence since 1925 and 20+ locations, ZEISS partners with industries including semiconductor, automotive, biomedical research, and medical technology, and is a leading manufacturer of eyeglass lenses, camera and cinema lenses, and precision optical systems.

What's the role?

The Head of SMT - US is responsible for leading and managing the overall operations and resources , ensuring the achievement of organizational goals and objectives . Th is role represents the organization and maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders , providing one voice to represent ZEISS SMT . Th e Head of SMT - US plays a pivotal role in fostering a positive work environment, building a cohesive, collaborative and high- performing team that drives the strategic direction of the organization . This includes business development , field marketing, leading the technology roadmap s , maintaining the installation basis, product sales and continuously develop ing partnership s , inc luding but not limited to ZEISS SMT, ZEISS INC, ZEISS SMT SSC teams and our customers. Finally, this person is r esponsible for developing the SMT - US organization , reporting structure s , synergies and d riv ing the cultural development of team leaders and members including talent management .

Sound Interesting?

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

What you'll do in this role :

Leadership and Management: Provide visionary leadership, fostering a positive and productive work environment. Lead and develop the e xecutive team and senior management.
Strategic Planning: Develop and execute strategic plans to advance the organization's mission and objectives . Identify opportunities for growth and improvement and allocate resources accordingly.
Financial Oversight: Manage the organization's budget and financial resources, ensuring financial stability and accountability through effective financial planning, reporting, and auditing processes.
Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including partners, clients, and the community. Advocate for the organization's interests and mission.
Sales: Ensure meeting s a les objectives and implementing negotiation excellence
Performance Monitoring: Establish performance metrics (KPI) and evaluate organizational progress towards goals. Implement corrective action s as necessary ensur ing objectives are met.
Compliance and Governance: Ensure the organization adheres to legal and regulatory requirements, maintaining high standards of governance and ethical conduct.
Operational Management: Oversee daily operations ensur ing efficient and effective management of resources. Implement policies / procedures to enhance productivity and compliance.
Global Key Account Management: Manages customer relations and facilitates global way of work for customers which are headquartered in USA
Culture and Innovation: Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure the recruitment, retention, and development of high - quality staff.

Your Qualifications

10+ years in semiconductor or strongly related sectors and a demonstrated history of senior leadership in a similar company.
Master's in Electrical Engineering , Materials Science, Physics, or a closely related field
Strong strategic thinking , planning and decision - making skills
Financial acumen and experience in budget management
Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders
Capability to work in matrix organization and manage your senior managers
Demonstrated ability to inspire and motivate teams towards achieving goals

The annual pay range for this position is $270,000 - $330,000

The pay offered for this role may be influenced by factors such as job location, scope of role, qualifications, education, experience, & complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent.

This position is also eligible for a performance bonus or sales commissions. ZEISS also offers robust benefits, including medical plans, retirement savings plan and paid time off.

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team

Debra Ann Rybolt

Zeiss provides Equal Employment Opportunity without unlawful regard to an Applicants race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, marital status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, citizen status, sexual orientation, pregnancy (includes childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical condition), genetic predisposition, carrier status, gender expression or identity, including transgender identity, or any other class or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law of the employee (or the people with whom the employee associates, including relatives and friends).
